o.text: Internationalism; from Russian доме́н (domén), French domaine, ultimately from Latin dominium.
From Old Anatolian Turkish قَاچَانْ (qaçan). Cognate with Turkmen haçan.
Calque of Russian вое́нное положе́ние (vojénnoje položénije).
Borrowed from Arabic تَمَامًا (tamāman), adverbial accusative of تَمَام (tamām). By surface analysis, tamam + -ən.
